title: Court Dismisses Atiku's Case Challenging Tinubu's 2027 Eligibility
detail: A court has dismissed Atiku Abubakar's suit challenging President Tinubu's eligibility to contest the 2027 election, according to AllAfrica. Grounds for the ruling were not detailed in the initial report.

media.caption: Court dismisses Atiku's case challenging Tinubu's eligibility for 2027
